source: Global Living Wage Coalition (Anker method) benchmarks and state minimum-wage notifications
notes: Living wage per worker-day = monthly figure divided by 26 working days.
GLWC figures are the 2025 Estimate updates (Living Wage Update reports, November 2025); each entry links to its source page.
For a district with no benchmark of its own, the scorecard uses the nearest GLWC benchmark of the same kind (rural/urban) and tags the grade estimated.

State minimum wages are copied from notifications and credible trackers with their dates; a value left null is not verified - never guess one. Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh are null because sources conflicted; each row's note says what was found on 24 Oct 2026 and which notification is needed. Official notification pages were not reachable (login or PDF only), so none of these four was filled from a secondary guess.
For multi-zone states the lowest zone rate is stored (the floor below which a wage is definitely illegal anywhere in the state); city zones are higher.

Minimum-wage entries checked 24 Oct 2026 against the India Briefing guide (updated 26 June 2026) and cross-checks; verify each figure against the state labour department notification before quoting it to judges.
